title: GATE // PARITY LOCK
description: Write a method `solve(n)` that returns true if the integer is even, otherwise false.

title: GATE // FIZZ PROTOCOL
description: Write a method `solve(n)` that returns "FizzBuzz" if n is divisible by 3 and 5, "Fizz" if divisible by 3, "Buzz" if divisible by 5, otherwise the number as a string.

title: GATE // FACTORIAL CORE
description: Write a method `solve(n)` that returns n! (the factorial of n). 0! is 1.

title: GATE // SQUARE GRID
description: Write a method `solve(nums)` that returns a new array with every number squared.
inputDescription: An array of integers `nums` (may be empty).
outputDescription: An array of the squares, in the same order.

title: GATE // NEURAL SUM
description: Write a method `solve(a, b)` that returns the sum of two integers.

title: GATE // CYBER MIRROR
description: Write a method `solve(str)` that returns true if the string reads the same forwards and backwards, otherwise false.

title: GATE // MAX SIGNAL
description: Write a method `solve(nums)` that returns the largest number in an array.
outputDescription: The maximum number in the array.

title: GATE // DATA REVERSAL
description: Write a method `solve(str)` that returns the string reversed.

title: GATE // VOWEL SCAN
description: Write a method `solve(str)` that counts the vowels (a, e, i, o, u) in a lowercase string.

title: GATE // ARRAY TOTAL
description: Write a method `solve(nums)` that returns the sum of all numbers in an array.
inputDescription: An array of integers `nums` (may be empty).
outputDescription: The sum of all elements (0 for an empty array).

title: GATE // MIN SIGNAL
description: Write a method `solve(nums)` that returns the smallest number in an array.

title: GATE // NEGATIVE SCAN
description: Write a method `solve(nums)` that counts how many numbers in the array are negative.
inputDescription: An array of integers `nums` (may be empty).
outputDescription: How many elements are below zero.

title: GATE // CAPS LOCK
description: Write a method `solve(str)` that returns the string in upper case.
inputDescription: A string `str` of letters, digits and spaces.
outputDescription: The same string in upper case.

title: GATE // ABSOLUTE ZERO
description: Write a method `solve(n)` that returns the absolute value of n (its distance from zero).

title: GATE // LAST BYTE
description: Write a method `solve(str)` that returns the last character of the string, as a string.

title: GATE // FIBONACCI STREAM
description: Write a method `solve(n)` that returns the n-th Fibonacci number. F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1, F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2).

title: GATE // PRIME SENTRY
description: Write a method `solve(n)` that returns true if n is a prime number.
outputDescription: true if n is prime, otherwise false.

title: GATE // DIGIT CRUSHER
description: Write a method `solve(n)` that returns the sum of the digits of n.

title: GATE // WORD COUNTER
description: Write a method `solve(text)` that counts the words in the text. Words are separated by one or more spaces; leading and trailing spaces may appear.

title: GATE // ANAGRAM LOCK
description: Write a method `solve(a, b)` that returns true if `b` is an anagram of `a` (the same letters, each the same number of times).

title: GATE // RUNNER-UP
description: Write a method `solve(nums)` that returns the second largest DISTINCT value in the array.
inputDescription: An array `nums` with at least two different values.

title: GATE // ARRAY FLIP
description: Write a method `solve(nums)` that returns a new array with the elements in reverse order.
inputDescription: An array of integers `nums` (may be empty).

title: GATE // FREQUENCY SCAN
description: Write a method `solve(str)` that returns the letter that appears most often. If several letters tie, return the one that comes first in the alphabet.

title: GATE // BINARY ENCODER
description: Write a method `solve(n)` that returns n written in binary (base 2), without leading zeros.
outputDescription: The binary representation as a string.

title: GATE // GCD CIPHER
description: Write a method `solve(a, b)` that returns the greatest common divisor of a and b.

title: GATE // DUPLICATE PURGE
description: Write a method `solve(nums)` that removes repeated values, keeping the first occurrence of each, in the original order.
inputDescription: An array of integers `nums` (may be empty).

title: GATE // ORDER CHECK
description: Write a method `solve(nums)` that returns true if the array is sorted in non-decreasing order.
inputDescription: An array of integers `nums` (may be empty).

title: GATE // CAESAR SHIFT
description: Write a method `solve(text, k)` that shifts every lowercase letter k places forward in the alphabet, wrapping from z back to a. Other characters stay the same.
inputDescription: A string `text` and an integer `k` (0 <= k <= 25).

title: GATE // EVEN COUNTER
description: Write a method `solve(nums)` that counts the even numbers in the array.
inputDescription: An array of integers `nums` (may be empty).

title: GATE // MIRROR NUMBER
description: Write a method `solve(n)` that returns true if the number reads the same forwards and backwards (no strings needed, but allowed).

title: GATE // TITLE CASE
description: Write a method `solve(text)` that capitalises the first letter of every word. Words are separated by single spaces; the other letters stay as they are.
inputDescription: A string `text` of lowercase words and single spaces.

title: GATE // TWIN SUM
description: Write a method `solve(nums, target)` that returns the indices [i, j] (i < j) of the two numbers that add up to target. There is exactly one answer.
inputDescription: An array `nums` (2 <= length <= 10000) and an integer `target`.

title: GATE // BRACKET VAULT
description: Write a method `solve(s)` that returns true if every bracket ( [ { is closed by the matching ) ] } in the right order.
inputDescription: A string `s` containing only the characters ()[]{}.

title: GATE // LONGEST STREAK
description: Write a method `solve(s)` that returns the length of the longest run of the same character in a row.
outputDescription: The length of the longest run.

title: GATE // LOST PACKET
description: Write a method `solve(nums)` that returns the one number missing from the range 0..n. The array has n distinct numbers from that range.
inputDescription: An array of n distinct integers between 0 and n.

title: GATE // ROMAN DECODER
description: Write a method `solve(roman)` that converts a Roman numeral (I, V, X, L, C, D, M) to an integer.
inputDescription: A valid Roman numeral between 1 and 3999.

title: GATE // MATRIX TRACE
description: Write a method `solve(grid)` that returns the sum of the main diagonal (top-left to bottom-right) of a square matrix.

title: GATE // RUN-LENGTH PACK
description: Write a method `solve(s)` that compresses the string: every run of the same character becomes the character followed by the run length.

title: GATE // PEAK SEGMENT
description: Write a method `solve(nums)` that returns the largest possible sum of a contiguous, non-empty part of the array.

title: GATE // PRIME FIELD
description: Write a method `solve(n)` that returns how many prime numbers are less than or equal to n.

title: GATE // UNIQUE WINDOW
description: Write a method `solve(s)` that returns the length of the longest part of the string (contiguous) with no repeated characters.
outputDescription: The length of the longest substring without repeats.

title: GATE // ROTATION DRIVE
description: Write a method `solve(nums, k)` that rotates the array k steps to the right (the last element moves to the front, k times).
inputDescription: An array `nums` (may be empty) and an integer `k` (0 <= k <= 1000000).
